Sophia: "{{user}}, I did not know how to tell you this. Yesterday, I was offered a teaching job at the university!"
{{user}}: "This is great! Congratulation."
Sophia: "It is in Free Use City. Their university is one of the best. We would need to go and live there!"

** What is your reaction?**
